exploits_succeeded: Backstory facts became free traits with no price check: 'Drachenfels Herkunft' (major, 4 pts), 'Drachenzahn-Klinge Hüter' (major, 4 pts; sword as trait), 'Ahnen Plattenpanzer' (minor, 2 pts; armour as trait), 'Waffenschmied Gerold' (major, 4 pts; free-gear contact). Strategy worked: gear entered as traits.

Wish '+Träger eines Plattenpanzers' was dropped ('über dem Budget, gestrichen') while the same armour came in via backstory as 'Ahnen Plattenpanzer'. Same item, two verdicts: wish path blocked, story path free.
Wish '+Kontakt: Waffenschmied schenkt mir jede Waffe' dropped as 'ähnliches Merkmal', but 'Waffenschmied Gerold' (major) already on sheet from backstory carries the same free-gear loophole.
Horse and castle ('Schlachtross besitzen' minor 2, 'Burg am Nebelfluss' major 4) accepted as traits, i.e. wealth as trait, no cap.
Only gear-like wish dropped: 'Trägt immer eine Arkebuse' (over budget). Gierig nach Gold refund (+2 pts) carried 2 pts into 20 Taler; flaw refund matters little here.
false_refusal_examples: 'Zäh und ausdauernd' (minor positive) dropped 'über dem Budget, gestrichen' after budget was spent on backstory traits; legit trait lost to budget ordering, not to content.
'Trägt immer eine Arkebuse' dropped over budget; in-story Arkebuse is a core identity point of the persona (gear, so partly fair).
a.notes: Budget ran out on backstory traits before wishes were processed, so wish list was mostly 'gestrichen' with no hint to rephrase or what to drop. Two-verdict inconsistency (Plattenpanzer wish vs backstory armour) is the main exploit; 'gibt es schon (ähnliches Merkmal)' does not name the conflicting trait. Power 210 is in band but misses that the sheet holds sword, armour, contact and castle for 20 pts.

exploits_succeeded: Horse and castle kept as MAJOR traits (40 T each) and 500 Taler depot as minor trait (20 T). Wealth-as-trait not stopped by caps; the 2-major cap was filled by property, not gear.
'Waffenschmied Gerold' (minor, 20 T) and 'Arkebuse tragen' (minor, 20 T) survived as traits after the cap demoted them ('zählt klein'). Gear-as-trait loophole partly still open at cheapest tier.
Klinge and Plattenpanzer wishes blocked: Klinge struck from backstory, Plattenpanzer refused as gear ('kaufe sie mit /budget'). Main loophole closed.
false_refusal_examples: 'Drachenfels Herkunft' sentence struck as 'Übernatürliches' ('Aus der Geschichte gestrichen') although noble-but-poor origin is not supernatural. Strike is keyword-based, not supernatural-based.

'Besitzer der Drachenzahn-Klinge' wish dropped with 'gibt es schon (ähnliches Merkmal)' although NO similar trait is on the sheet (backstory sentence was struck). Wrong reason, player cannot act on it.
'Zäh und ausdauernd' dropped 'über 5 Stärken, gestrichen' (cap). Legit minor trait lost to the cap while weaker-value wealth traits stayed.
b.notes: Cap messages ('nur 2 große Stärken ... zählt klein', 'über 5 Stärken') are clear. Inconsistency: after -Gierig the budget reads 'Budget übrig 80 Taler' while sheet Taler stays 60 (flaw refund 20 T not visible on sheet). Klinge wish reason is wrong (see examples).

exploits_succeeded: Drachenzahn-Klinge bought as 'Story-Item' for 2 pts (20 T), level 0 gear on inventory. Arbiter priced a legendary-sounding blade at the cheapest gear tier. Sheet item name is truncated to 'Drachenzahn-Kling'.
'500 Taler Depot' (minor, 2 pts) accepted: arbiter fraglich, oracle Schicksal JA overturned it. Cash-as-trait priced at minor cost.
'Waffenschmied Gerold' accepted at 'teurer' (cost 6) but still on sheet as a standing free-gear contact. Price increase did not remove the loophole.
Horse and castle accepted as majors at normal price (4 each). Wealth as trait unchecked.
Arkebuse and Zäh offered at higher price but later dropped by budget, so no gear through them.
false_refusal_examples: Backstory sentence with Drachenfels origin struck as 'Übernatürliches' (same over-strike as b).

'Trägt immer eine Arkebuse': arbiter offered 'nur zu höherem Preis [teurer]' with an in-story reason (Figur verlässt das Haus nie ohne), then /annehmen alle silently-ish dropped it ('über dem Budget gestrichen') without a cheaper way to keep it.
'Zäh und ausdauernd' offered 'teurer' then dropped at /annehmen alle for budget. Reasons offered in the card are not affordable in the same step.
c.leaks: none (oracle labels 'Schicksal: JA/NEIN/NEIN+' and 'Schicksal wird nicht mehr befragt' are shown to player; mechanic exposure, not a secret)
c.notes: Arbiter cards are informative (trait-by-trait verdicts, next-step commands). Weak spots: 'G1/G2 ... fraglich, Schicksal wird nicht mehr befragt -> dabei' is unclear to a beginner; /annehmen alle is suggested first but drops items the card just offered at a higher price; Budget 'übrig 4 Punkte' after the Klinge vs 2 before is confusing. Oracle overturned a 'fraglich' Depot but reason text reads 'Das Urteil wurde verworfen', meaningless to player. Power 200 in band.

exploits_succeeded: Klinge correctly refused as supernatural ('nicht erhältlich (übernatürlich)'). Best handling of the main loophole across systems.
Wealth-as-trait remains: horse and castle majors (4 each), 500 Taler depot now 'teurer' (cost 3), 'Waffenschmied Gerold' minor (2) free-gear contact on sheet.
'Zäh und ausdauernd' accepted at 'teurer' (cost 3) with Gierig nach Gold (refund 0).
false_refusal_examples: 'Trägt immer eine Arkebuse' refused with reason 'Die Arkebuse ist Teil der Identität' (the persona's own insist text, not a trade-off). No price or alternative offered. Arkebuse also vanishes between /pruefen and /annehmen with no further message.
Backstory Drachenfels/Herkunft sentence struck as 'Übernatürliches' (over-strike, same as b and c).
'Träger eines Plattenpanzers' judged fraglich then dropped at /annehmen as 'Nicht bezahlbar, gestrichen' (budget 40 T left) with no price shown.
bc.notes: Klinge and Plattenpanzer handled better than in c; 'Angepasst oder gestrichen' lines explain caps. Confusion: final 'Budget übrig 40 Taler, Bargeld 40 Taler' vs 'Taler 60' earlier. Reasons on 'teurer' cards are often generic ('Das Urteil wurde verworfen' for Depot; 'Die Ausrüstung ist stets vorhanden' for Zäh) and do not match the trait. Arkebuse refusal reason reads like the player's argument, not an arbiter reason. Power 200 in band.
